title: What Does Salesforce Do?
summary: Explore what Salesforce does, the ways it helps strengthen customer relationships, and how the world’s #1 agentic CRM helps businesses become agentic enterprises.
body_markdown:
Salesforce is the world’s #1 agentic CRM platform. It gives employees and AI agents a shared foundation of real customer data and business logic to take action together — not just have conversations — so companies of any size or industry can connect with customers and grow.


Managing customer relationships, streamlining sales, automating marketing, and delivering customer service — all on one AI-powered platform.


Yes, Salesforce provides cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM), giving AI-powered businesses tools and out-of-the-box agents to manage customer records, track sales pipelines, generate marketing campaigns, and handle support requests in one central location. It’s part of Salesforce’s[Customer 360](https://www.salesforce.com/products/what-is-customer-360/) , that helps businesses manage sales, marketing, service, commerce, and more.


Salesforce’s products include[Agentforce Sales](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/) ,[Agentforce Service](https://www.salesforce.com/service/) ,[Agentforce Marketing](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/) ,[Agentforce Commerce](https://www.salesforce.com/commerce/) ,[Headless 360 platform](https://www.salesforce.com/platform/) ,[Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/) , and[Slack](http://salesforce.com/slack) . We’ve also built a whole[Customer Success](https://www.salesforce.com/services/) ecosystem to help customers get the most out of their Salesforce investment. This includes collaborating with our[Professional Services](https://www.salesforce.com/services/professional-services/) team to set up your Salesforce instance, our[AppExchange](https://appexchange.salesforce.com/) that lets you customize Salesforce products, and the ability to train your entire workforce on Salesforce and in-demand skills for free with[Trailhead](https://www.salesforce.com/trailhead/) .


Salesforce is best known as the world’s #1 agentic[CRM](http://salesforce.com/crm) . We were the first company to put business software in the cloud, and are still redefining what a CRM can do by combining trusted data with autonomous AI agents.


Beyond product, Salesforce is known for its[values-driven model](https://www.salesforce.com/company/our-values/) : Trust, customer success, innovation, equality, and sustainability — backed by the[1-1-1 philanthropic model](https://www.salesforce.com/company/pledge/) (1% of equity, product, and employee time donated). To date: $912M+ in grants, 10.65+ million volunteer hours, and product donations to 64.9K+ nonprofits and schools.


We also believe technology should serve a broader purpose. Salesforce has created solutions to help organizations track and reduce their environmental impact, and[Trailhead](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/) modules to help employees build new skills and reskill for the future.


[Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/) is the intelligence that powers your business across Salesforce products and anywhere else you integrate it, all within the guardrails you set. It’s where you can build, test, deploy and govern AI agents that are always on and can take action any time of day or night.


Yes.[Salesforce for Small Business](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/) is scalable with a suite of tools tailored to SMBs. It also integrates seamlessly with third-party apps to ensure that all processes are aligned. With Salesforce, upgrades happen automatically via the cloud, you receive the same security standards demanded by our most stringent customers, and our products can scale with you. Salesforce SMB products include[Free Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/free-crm/) ,[Starter Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/starter/) , and[Pro Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/pro-suite/) .


Migrating from another CRM to Salesforce can be a smooth process if approached systematically. The steps involved in planning and executing a successful[CRM implementation](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/crm-implementation/) include performing a needs assessment, customization tailored to your existing workflows and tools, training and support, and ongoing evaluation and iteration.


Salesforce is used across nearly every sector, including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, technology, higher education, and public sector organizations. Because its platform is customizable, companies adapt it to handle industry-specific compliance, operations, and customer relationships. Learn more about[Salesforce Industries here](https://www.salesforce.com/industries/) .


Yes. Agentforce lets companies build and deploy AI agents that can autonomously take action across every department. These actions include reaching out to sales leads and closing deals, responding to customer issues, creating and running marketing campaigns, and providing personalized shopping recommendations. Agents also work alongside humans to answer employee questions, resolve issues, and accelerate everyday tasks in the natural flow of work.


Salesforce costs and pricing structures vary based on the product and plan. Have a look at the[Salesforce product pricing here](https://www.salesforce.com/pricing/) .


On average, our customers see a 55% ROI (return on investment) when they implement Salesforce. And it’s not just some customers who benefit from switching: 98% of Salesforce customers achieve a positive ROI.


That’s because we have an entire support ecosystem to help you reach your goals fast. With Salesforce, you can lower costs and boost productivity across your entire organization using one trusted[platform](https://www.salesforce.com/platform/) . It increases productivity with the help of AI agents, and it drives efficient growth by helping your employees exceed customer expectations.


Most AI agents only know what you tell them. Slackbot knows how your business actually works. Slackbot is your AI agent built into Slack with full context of your conversations, files, decisions, and connected data. That means it doesn’t just answer questions like a generic chatbot, it takes action. It works across every app and specialized AI agent already connected to Slack, so you never have to know which tool does what. Just say what needs to happen, and Slackbot will find the right path and get it done.
